title: ORE Property Module
description: Identity, location, and physical characteristics of the property. ORE v0.1 scope is US industrial (single-tenant and multi-tenant).

name.description: Display name of the property, e.g. "4250 Valley Blvd" or "Gateway Logistics Center".

propertyType.description: Asset class. ORE v0.1 supports industrial only; future versions will widen this enum.

propertySubtype.description: Industrial subtype. Use "other" with a note in `description` if none fit.

tenancy.description: Single-tenant or multi-tenant configuration as currently operated.

description.description: Free-text narrative description of the property.

address.description: Situs address. ORE v0.1 scope is US properties only.

apn.description: Assessor's parcel number, formatted as it appears on the assessor roll.

landAcres.description: Land area of this parcel in acres.

siteAreaAcres.description: Total site area in acres across all parcels. If `parcels[].landAcres` are provided, this should equal their sum.

physical.description: Physical and functional characteristics of the improvements.

buildingSF.description: Total rentable building area in square feet. The denominator for per-SF metrics and pro-rata shares unless a lease overrides it.

officeSF.description: Office build-out area in square feet, included within buildingSF.

mezzanineSF.description: Mezzanine area in square feet. State whether included in buildingSF via `notes` if ambiguous.

clearHeightFt.description: Minimum clear height in feet, measured at the first interior column line or lowest hanging obstruction per market convention.

railServed.description: Whether the property has active rail service.

sprinkler.description: Fire sprinkler system type. "wet" covers calculated/ordinary wet systems that are not ESFR.

truckCourtDepthFt.description: Truck court depth in feet at the primary loading position.

coverageRatio.description: Building footprint divided by site area (floor-area ratio for single-story industrial), expressed as a decimal, e.g. 0.45.

fencedYard.description: Whether the property has a secured/fenced yard area.

yardAcres.description: Usable yard area in acres, if a meaningful component of value (IOS or excess land).

notes.description: Free-text notes on measurement conventions, pending entitlements, or anything else a reader needs to interpret this module correctly.
